messages:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: spike in 5xx (502/504) + timeouts on /v1/generate in us-east-1. Alerting on-call. Threshold breached: 3x baseline error-rate.
ops-bot: paging dev on-call: @devon (pagerduty#P12345) — escalation sent.
anna: I'm up — seeing alerts too. How wide is the impact? any customer-facing 429s?
devon: investigating. initial look at edge logs: traffic shows a huge surge of 429s from our quota-enforcer service starting 04:12 UTC, followed by retries from clients, then gateway 502/504. feels like cascading rate-limit -> retry storm -> backend exhaustion.
sahil: confirming in prometheus: 429s spiked from ~0.2% to 18% at 04:12, 5xx jumped to 12% at 04:14. p50 latency up ~200ms.
marie: Quick ask — did any config change land around that time? I saw a PR for quota tightening earlier today.
devon: good catch. checking deploy history... there was a deploy at 04:10 that rolled out quota-enforcer v2 to production with a stricter global limit. looking at the git tag now: commit sha abc1234.
luke: posting relevant logs:
```
[04:12:07] ingress-gateway: upstream response 429 from quota-enforcer (client_id=svc-frontend)
[04:12:08] frontend: retrying request (attempt=1) -> 429
[04:12:09] ingress-gateway: upstream error 502 backend unavailable
[04:12:10] redis-kv: connection_pool_exhausted
[04:12:11] frontend: timeout after 10s
```
anna: so this looks like the new global quota config was accidentally too strict (applied to hosted and dedicated). clients retried aggressively and filled connection pools.
devon: mitigation plan (running):
  1) immediately rollback quota-enforcer v2 rollout to previous stable (v1).
  2) temporarily increase ingress gateway connection pool + backend replica count in us-east-1.
  3) enable server-side soft-429 backoff (100ms jittered) for 30m to avoid retry storm.
  4) open temporary per-customer higher quota for affected enterprise tenants.
  5) notify customers w/ elevated errors via status page and CS.
Can someone take 1 and 3? I'll do 2 and 4.
marie: I'm on 1 (rolling back). executing helm rollback now.
marie: helm rollback quota-enforcer release=quota-enforcer-prod --to-revision=24 -> in progress.
marie: rollback completed at 04:18.
luke: I'm toggling soft backoff on API gateway config: setting X-Server-Backoff: true (feature-flag).
luke: backoff enabled. pushing guardrails: max retries from clients now 3.
devon: scaled backend replicas + increased connection pool. commands I ran:
```
kubectl scale deployment/frontend --replicas=12 -n prod
kubectl set env deployment/ingress-gw CONN_POOL_SIZE=500 -n infra
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: quota-enforcer rollback succeeded (release -> v1, revision 24).
ops-bot: autoscaler: frontend replicas scaled to 12 in us-east-1.
anna: metrics update: error-rate dropping from 12% -> 4% within 3m of rollback. 429s down to 1.2%. p95 latency falling.
sahil: adding more detail: root cause appears to be a mis-scoped config change that applied global tenant limits instead of per-tenant. PR #842 had the wrong selector.
marie: customer impact: Intermittent generation failures for ~15% of requests between 04:12-04:20. Affected region: us-east-1. Some enterprise customers reported failed jobs and timeouts. CS notified.
anna: status page draft: "We're investigating elevated errors impacting text generation in us-east-1. Mitigation in progress. We will update in 30m or on resolution." Anyone want to push?
sahil: I'll publish the status update now.
oncall-ml: FYI rerouted some traffic to model-fallback for sensitive customers to reduce load on heavy models. This prevented model-compounding failures.
luke: confirming stabilization: last 5m error-rate = 0.9%, p50 latency back to baseline.
devon: switching to monitoring/handoff mode. setting incident severity to Sev2 -> we had major customer impact but mitigation done. folks still keep eyes on related dashboards for 2h.
anna: creating quick incident summary for next on-call: cause = quota-enforcer v2 misconfig (global vs per-tenant); effect = 429 spike -> client retries -> backend pool exhaustion -> 502/504; mitigation = rollback + scale + soft backoff + temporary per-customer quotas + traffic routing.
marie: tagging postmortem owner: @sahil. sahil, can you own and add action items?
sahil: taking it. initial action items I'll add to the postmortem: [1] fix selector bug in PR #842 and add unit test, [2] add rollout gating for quota changes (canary + 5% then widen), [3] implement server-side circuit-breaker to shed load instead of failing open, [4] add synthetic test that hits quota-enforcer under load pre-deploy, [5] update runbook for retry/backoff guidance for SDK users.
anna: handoff: @devon you're oncall for the next 30m watch window, then @luke will take over. moving to monitoring channel.
devon: acknowledged. I'll keep alerts unmuted and check in at +30m.
luke: adding note — we should also add an automated guard in CI to prevent global selector mis-scope in quota PRs.
ops-bot: incident-bot: incident state -> mitigated. timeline recorded.
anna: thanks everyone. please add any follow-ups to the postmortem ticket INCD-2026.
marie: CS will follow up customers with timeline + RCA once postmortem is ready.
sahil: will have draft RCA by EOD. assigning owners for action items.
anna: closing thread from active paging; monitoring continues. :white_check_mark:
